div.head: Cn 1018 1.3
div.ab: Uton swiðe georne fram sinnan acirran. 7 ure misdæda geornlice betan. 7 ænne god rihtlice lufian 7 wurðian. 7 ænne cristendom anrædlice healdan. 7 ælcne hæðendom georne forbugan.
Uton swiðe georne fram sinnan acirran and ure misdæda geornlice betan, and ænne God rihtlice lufian and wurðian, and ænne Cristendom anrædlice healdan, and ælcne hæðendom georne forbugan.
Let us turn very zealously from sins, and earnestly atone for our misdeeds, and duly love and honour one God, and singlemindedly hold one Christian faith, and zealously avoid every heathen practice.
Let us turn very readily from sins and sincerely repent our misdeeds, praise and honor the one God, steadfastly observe the one Christian faith, and zealously reject each heathen practice.
